svg.title: FMCW Radar Project Roadmap
svg.desc: 5-phase roadmap for building an FMCW radar simulation with bistatic geometry and algorithm-based range enhancement

g.text: Python (radarsimpy) + MATLAB · Study all 4 reference repos · Understand beat signal & FFT pipeline
Waveform gen · Beat signal · Range FFT · Range-Doppler map · CA-CFAR detection
Apply algorithms on top of bistatic geometry · Measure SNR gain · Plot range maps
Monostatic vs bistatic comparison · Algorithm benchmarking · Detection probability plots
Final output — Simulation + range enhancement report

svg.text: Tools: radarsimpy (Python) · MATLAB · NumPy · Matplotlib · reference repos as study guides
